concerns.text: Task T004 runs a correlation pipeline that records Pearson‑r statistics but the specification (FR‑010, SC‑001, Constitution VI) explicitly requires a **paired t‑test** on variance differences between entropy‑matched prompt pairs (p < 0.05). The paired t‑test is omitted, weakening the required statistical validation.

Task T005 only checks that at least one model yields a statistically significant correlation (p < 0.05). It does not perform the mandated **paired t‑test** on variance differences nor report the effect size, leaving FR‑010 and SC‑001 unfulfilled.

Core module T003 implements the semantic‑entropy proxy and activation‑variance capture but does **not** include any task that computes **Mean Squared Error (MSE) quantization error** on a subset of activations as required by **FR‑009**.
No task records the **Spearman correlation** between activation variance and MSE quantization error (required by **FR‑011**), nor validates its significance.

Task T008 adds the EntropyRouter and integrates it into the quantizer, but there is no downstream task that **demonstrates that the selected rotation matrix reduces MSE** relative to the static baseline (required by **FR‑012**).

Evaluation task T011 computes FID, CLIP, MSE, and runtime overhead, yet it does not verify the **MSE reduction per‑prompt** attributable to the router versus the static baseline, nor does it reference the paired‑t‑test requirement from the constitution.

The entropy‑cutoff sensitivity sweep (T012) records FID variance but does not include any verification that the **paired t‑test** condition (SC‑001) is satisfied before the sweep, nor does it report the required effect‑size threshold.
